description: This Java source file defines the `BigPictureSocialIntentService` class, which is an Android `IntentService` responsible for handling asynchronous updates to social notifications that utilize `BigPictureStyle`. It processes comment actions from users, updates notifications dynamically with new comments, and manages notification recreation in case the app process is killed. The class includes methods for extracting remote input, rebuilding notification styles, and managing notification updates.

classes.name: BigPictureSocialIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService handling comments updates for social notifications with BigPictureStyle, including notification recreation and comment processing.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Overrides IntentService method to handle incoming intents, specifically processing comment actions.

methods.name: handleActionComment
methods.description: Processes a comment string, updates the existing notification with the new comment.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the remote input comment message from the intent.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigPictureStyle
methods.description: Recreates and configures the notification builder with BigPictureStyle, including remote input setup and notification styling.
